meta.purpose: Sourced outcomes from other Airship accounts, keyed to playbook levers, so a recommendation can say what the work produces elsewhere instead of only that the client is not doing it.
meta.rule: Nothing here may be written by a model. Every entry needs a real source document, a date, and a figure quoted from it. A lever with no entry renders no proof point — that is the intended behaviour, not a gap to fill. See reference.md, 'Proof points'.
meta.audience: These reviews are marked internal Airship use, prepared for the account team. An entry cleared for that is not automatically cleared for a client-facing deck; check before lifting one out.
meta.lever_keys: Must match campaign_playbook.json levers[].key — an unknown key silently never matches.
